Auto: Camera setting value: the camera decides. Short, shown in a small control.
Auto shutter: Camera mode that takes the photo itself when the page is steady.
Auto-enhance: Setting: improve contrast and brightness automatically.
Book: Task chip: scan the open pages of a book. A noun.
Camera photo: Default name of a photo taken with the camera. A noun.
Copy again: Button: print another copy of the same pages.
Crop: Toolbar button in the page viewer: change the crop of this page. A verb.
Flash: Camera control: the flash light, not Adobe Flash.
Last scan: Spoken label of the thumbnail that shows the most recent scan.
Move: Menu in the page selection bar, and the page viewer toolbar button: move the page to another place. A verb.
Move to Beginning: Menu item: move the page to the start of the queue.
Move to End: Menu item: move the page to the end of the queue.
Next page: Spoken action name for VoiceOver; moves to the next page of the document.
Options: Button at the bottom of the iPhone scan screen that opens everything about what is saved: type, format, size. A noun, short.
Page: Spoken label of the large page image in the quick scan screen, and of a page thumbnail. A noun.
Previous page: Spoken action name for VoiceOver; moves to the previous page.
Scan area: Title of the flatbed preview where the area to scan is chosen. A noun.
Split|setting: Setting label: how facing pages of a book or sheets are split into pages or documents. A noun. The button is Split.
Take photo: Spoken label of the shutter button.
Text: Output kind: the recognised text of the pages (OCR) as a text file; also the page viewer button that shows the recognised text. Not body text.
Type: Row of the Options sheet: what is being scanned (Document, Photos, ID card). A noun, not the verb.
Adjust Crop: Title of the crop editor window: move the corners of the cropped area.
Copy Diagnostics: Button: put the technical report on the clipboard so it can be pasted into an email.
Copy Text: Menu item: put the recognised text of the page on the clipboard.
Keep Fronts Only: Banner button: save only the front sides that were scanned.
Move Earlier: Context menu item: move the page one place towards the start.
Move Later: Context menu item: move the page one place towards the end.
Remove Page: Context menu item: take the page out of the queue. No saved file is deleted.
Scan Settings: Toolbar button that shows the settings sidebar.
Split Here: Button in the spread editor: cut the spread at the line. A verb.
